entities.name: Voda Sea
entities.description: Sea in the Domains of Dominaria connected to the Vodalian merfolk empire.

entities.name: Galina
entities.description: Led her people from Sarpadia to Etlan Shiis, seized control of the city and became empress of New Vodalia.

entities.name: Etlan Shiis
entities.description: City whose merfolk lived under a council for thousands of years.

entities.name: Old Voda Sea
entities.description: Original sea near Sarpadia, renamed when Galina left.

entities.name: Tolarian Temporal Disaster
entities.description: Disaster after which Galina and her retinue appeared in the sea.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Place near which the Voda Sea originally lay.

events.summary: Galina leads her people away from Sarpadia to Etlan Shiis, bringing the Voda Sea's name; the original is renamed Old Voda Sea.
events.quote: when Galina led her people away from there and settled in their new location of Etlan Shiis

events.summary: Galina and her retinue take control of Etlan Shiis, murdering the councilors and making Galina empress.
events.quote: murdering the councilors and placing Galina as empress of the new realm

relations.quote: placing Galina as empress of the new realm
